title: LongLong Automation V17
features:
• 24/7 Auto Farm: Auto Buy, Upgrade, Powers, Fruit, CashDrops, Vines
• Prestige Automation: Auto Rebirth, Evolve, Ascend with Timer logic
• UI-Less Phone Deals (Accept, Raise One, Reject)
• Seamless Auto-Resume: Automatically restores state after crash/rejoin
• Discord Webhooks: Event alerts & 30m Periodic Stat Reports
• Auto Server Hop: Based on player count or custom time interval
• Anti-Ban: Humanized random delays & Extended Anti-AFK jumps
• Performance Mode: Strips graphics for maximum 24/7 FPS
• Advanced Customization: Sliders for all loop delays & harvest settings
• Built-in Event Logger & Live Tracker GUI

changelog.message: Initial release of LongLong Automation V17
